candidates.claim: ACL VTY_MGMT on sw-ot-01, applied with SSH input to vty lines 0-4 and 5-15, permits 192.168.30.0/24 (CORP) at line 203, which the management policy does not allow because device management is permitted only from MGMT 10.10.99.0/24.
candidates.remediation: Remove the permit entry for 192.168.30.0/24 from ACL VTY_MGMT on sw-ot-01 so that only 10.10.99.0/24 is permitted.

candidates.claim: The baseline comparison shows a permit entry added to ACL VTY_MGMT on sw-ot-01 at line 203 for 192.168.30.0/24, which is not in the approved baseline.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile this added entry against the change record and revert it to the approved baseline unless it is authorized.
